name: Venom to the Undercity
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
The venom you gathered from the Witherbark's spider god is quite a find!  I've been able to kill nearly two dozen rabbits with just a drop of the stuff.  Granted, some of those rabbits were very young and small enough to fit in the palm of one's hand so I'm certain their resistance to toxins was low, but it can't be denied that this poison is powerful!

I'd like a sample sent to my superior, Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.  I am positive he would want to test this himself.
narrative.objectives: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, very good. Lydon mentioned the poison in this parcel is the most potent he has come in contact with, and is busy working on new applications with it.

With luck, we will find many.

Thank you, adventurer. Your service to the Royal Apothecary Society is undeniable.
narrative.requestItemsText: Word was sent of your coming, adventurer. You have a parcel for me?

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 43 to 55, 32,150 XP in all.

quests.name: Venom Bottles
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Undamaged Venom Sac
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Consult Master Gadrin
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

quests.name: The Spider God
quests.objectiveText: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.

quests.name: Summoning Shadra
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Venom to the Undercity
quests.objectiveText: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
